narrative_purpose: The chapter's core evidence: a flatworm's head-versus-tail target morphology lives in its bioelectric voltage state, and flattening that state rewrites the body to two heads — a change remembered across re-cuttings, with no gene edited.
subject: A two-panel diagram of a flatworm and its voltage state. LEFT PANEL: a normal flatworm with a single rounded head (two eyespots) at one end and a pointed tail at the other, beside a horizontal voltage-bar that fades smoothly from bright cyan at the head end to deep magenta at the tail end (a head-to-tail gradient). RIGHT PANEL: the same worm regrown with a rounded head at BOTH ends, no tail, beside a voltage-bar that is now a flat uniform cyan all along its length (the gradient erased). A small looping curved motif between the two panels suggests the two-headed form persists when cut again.
scene: A comparison of a normal one-headed worm with a normal head-tail voltage gradient, and a rewritten two-headed worm with a flattened uniform voltage.
camera: A flat schematic diptych, worm and its voltage-bar paired in each panel, the two panels side by side.
light: Bioluminescent key from the worms and the voltage-bars; the head-to-tail gradient reading as a cyan-to-magenta fade, the flattened state as uniform cyan.
palette: Void-indigo base; the normal voltage-bar fading cyan-to-magenta; the flattened bar uniform Pandora cyan; the worms in soft luminous cyan.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate as a luminous schematic, hand-painted texture, not vector-flat.
detail_level: Crisp on the one-head-vs-two-head bodies and on the graded-vs-flat voltage bars so the mapping between voltage and shape reads instantly; plain dark margins for callouts.
composition: Two equal panels with a dark gutter between; worm-plus-voltage-bar paired in each; the persistence loop-motif in the gutter; dark margins for labels.
consistency_notes: The mapping that must read: graded voltage = one head/one tail; flat voltage = two heads. The voltage-bars are subjects, not annotation. Leave dark margins for labels.
